facts.event: Tilde 在黎明时观看阳光切过城市、落向红色港口，回想 Widdin 在她能说完整句子之前就已陷落，她只想象过那座北方城池与著名河流。
facts.anchor: I watched the dawn come in, cutting bright across the city

facts.event: 她望见 Daostet 城中广场上那尊以 Liran 面孔铸成的巨像，手指指向天空。
facts.anchor: the gleaming statue I could see from the sprawling palace

facts.event: 今日 Cynghal 帝国的权力归属将见分晓：Galen 与 Wing 所爱的 Conrin、凶悍的 Alar，或 Merogia 血统的女王 Tilde。
facts.anchor: Today, the swing of power in the Cynghal empire would be decided.

facts.event: Ziyan 向 Tilde 报告他已替换国王寝宫里的香炉，说国王很安静、提过她一次和一个孩子，随后谈起圣战。
facts.anchor: I have replaced the censer in the king

facts.event: Ziyan 说 Conrin 昨天要求议会到 blue chamber 集合，那是离东门最远的厅，而那个厅不会随 Liran，她的影响力可能消退。
facts.anchor: Conrin yesterday asked the council to gather in the chamber of blue

facts.event: Tilde 不顾 Hadiah 的抗议，把她连同困惑的 Muirenn 与 Helwinde 一起送进城中的私室，好让她们远离王宫并延续血脉。
facts.anchor: Hadiah, despite her protests, I had sent with a baffled Muirenn and Helwinde

facts.event: 远处城门响起 Galenish 号角，她们出发，与等在房外的六名护卫会合——全是 Captain Perin 挑选的精锐。
facts.anchor: joined the six of my guards who were waiting outside my rooms

facts.event: 东门升起灰旗，Marolyn 说 Dagobert 来了、Merovin 会去迎他；Tilde 命人警告 Palati Odon 新旗已升起，并判断国王卫队会有话说。
facts.anchor: The east gate has raised a grey flag
